subject: POC plan and final readout scheduling - Coral Health
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Lena Lopez <lena@coralhealth.com>, Tom Wu <tomw@coralhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Jul 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: POC plan and next steps - Coral Health

Hi Lena / Tom -

Thanks again for the productive call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

Recap (from discovery)
- Primary goal: validate that Redwood's Dedicated inference can meet Coral Health latency SLOs (95th percentile < 250ms for 512 tokens) and fit within your cost targets for batch processing of nightly ingestion pipelines.
- Key constraints: PHI data routing must remain in your VPC during the trial; procurement needs SOC 2 Type II evidence for the trial environment.

Proposed POC success criteria (attached):
1) Latency: 95th pctl <= 250ms for 512-token inference in dedicated pool under simulated production traffic (see attached test plan).
2) Throughput: support sustained 50 qps with autoscaling behavior within 60s.
3) Model parity: no significant degradation in generation quality vs. your current baseline (evaluation sample set TBD).
4) Security: Private deployment with customer-managed keys + evidence of SOC2 controls (we'll provide our compliance pack).

Proposed timeline
- Trial window: Jul 18 - Jul 29 (10 business days of validation + initial tuning)
- Final readout & exec review: week of Aug 2 (propose Tue Aug 3 10:00 PT)

Owners / responsibilities
- Redwood: Marissa (POC lead) for onboarding, Neha for infra/config, Rishi for evaluation metrics and readout deck.
- Coral Health: Lena (product owner), Tom (engineering), procurement contact for contracting.

Next steps
- Please confirm the success criteria in the attached spreadsheet and either confirm the trial window above or propose alternatives.
- Procurement contact: please loop in the procurement owner if you want us to start the SOW/PO discussion now.

Attachments: coral_poc_success_criteria.xlsx (success criteria + test plan)

Thanks -
Marcus Lin
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142

From: Lena Lopez <lena@coralhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Wu <tomw@coralhealth.com>, Asha Patel <asha.patel@coralhealth.com>, procurement <procurement@coralhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Jul 2027 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC plan and next steps - Coral Health

Thanks Marcus - this is great and captures the discussion. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Success criteria: the four bullets look right. We'll add a small qualitative pass/fail for hallucination rate on our clinical prompts (threshold: <3% on sampled prompts). Can you add that to the spreadsheet?

2) SOC 2 evidence: procurement wants your compliance pack and the SOC 2 Type II report before we start. I've CC'd procurement and Asha (legal) to the thread.

3) Trial window: Jul 18 - 29 works for our team, but engineering asks for one extra buffer day for onboarding (so Jul 17 - 30 would be safer). Can Redwood accommodate that?

4) Final readout: Aug 3 tentative is fine. We'll confirm exec availability once procurement schedules their review.

Apologies - quick note below from Tom on expected integration points: 

> On Fri, Jul 9, 2027 at 09:45 AM Tom Wu <tomw@coralhealth.com> wrote:
> 
> Marcus - engineering will need an SSH jump host + VPC peering details and a small sample dataset (de-identified) for the first two days. Who on Redwood will coordinate infra?
>
Marcus / Marissa - can you confirm infra owner and whether the SOW draft can include the buffer day?

Best,
Lena
Head of Product, Coral Health
Lena.lopez@coralhealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 10 Jul 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC plan and next steps - Coral Health

Thanks - looping in the infra and evaluation owners and attaching a short SOW draft that includes a one-day buffer on both ends. High-level plan below (will update the shared spreadsheet with the hallucination metric Lena requested):

Evaluation plan (owner)
- Day -1 to 0 (Neha): infra setup - VPC peering, SSH jump host, KMS config, test certs.
- Day 1-3 (Neha + Tom): ingestion of de-identified sample dataset, baseline run, and observed latency metrics.
- Day 4-8 (Rishi + Coral eng): quality eval on 1k prompts (compute hallucination and relevance), tuning if needed.
- Day 9-10 (Marissa + Rishi): final stability run and prep readout deck.

Deliverables / owners
- Infra checklist and runbook (Neha) - delivered Day 0
- Evaluation metrics & raw results (Rishi) - delivered Day 9
- Readout deck (Marissa) - delivered Day 10

SOW / contracting
- I've attached a draft SOW (Coral_RD_SOW_draft.pdf). If procurement is happy we can route for an expedited signature via DocuSign (link below).

Proposed exec readout times (please confirm):
- Tue Aug 3, 10:00 - 10:45 PT (preferred)
- Wed Aug 4, 11:00 - 11:45 PT (backup)

If Coral confirms the procurement/SOC2 sign-off, we'll kick off infra the week of Jul 12 so we're ready for the Jul 17 onboarding day.

DocuSign: https://docusign.example.com/rooms/ABC123

Thanks -

Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC plan and next steps - Coral Health

Lena / Tom - thanks for the quick replies and alignment. Two quick asks so we can lock calendar & contracting: 

1) Confirm trial dates: Jul 17 - 30 (we'll treat Jul 17 as onboarding/setup day). Reply with a confirm or propose alternate window.

2) Confirm final readout: we'd like to schedule the exec readout for Tue Aug 3 10:00 - 10:45 PT. Please confirm exec availability or propose one of the backup slots Marissa listed.

If both items are a go we'll: 
- Kick off infra the week of Jul 12 (Neha will reach out to Tom to coordinate jump host + peering).
- Send the SOW draft to procurement for signature (Marissa will push the DocuSign link).
- Prepare an agenda for the readout (Rishi will own metrics + Marissa will own product implications).

Decision process (readout -> contract):
- Go: exec signoff -> procurement signs SOW -> Redwood issues invoice for reserved capacity -> onboarding for production timeline.
- No-go: collect fail criteria and decision memo -> optional second iteration with tuned config or end POC.

Attachments referenced: Coral_RD_SOW_draft.pdf, coral_poc_success_criteria.xlsx

Meeting invite: [Proposed: Tue Aug 3 10:00 PT - Exec Readout (Coral Health POC)]

Thanks and looking forward -
Marcus
